backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented methods.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report describing implemented features, associated files, components, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Reference file containing prewritten summaries for multiple frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all page routes and renders global layout including ThemeToggleBar and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/DiamondIcon.tsx: Renders a styled ♦ character as a reusable icon component.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggleBar.t: Bottom bar offering light/dark theme switching and cycling between blue, purple, and green color schemes with a visual indicator.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useColorScheme.ts: Manages blue/purple/green color-scheme state with persistence and applies it via a data attribute.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, identity loading, and status management using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module for future backend-related React Query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Handles light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and applies the appropriate class to the document root.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with multiple color schemes.
frontend/src/lib/mgp.ts: Provides MGP ID validation and error messaging utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Implements a checkout form with shipping/payment fields and navigates to order confirmation with a random arrival date.
frontend/src/pages/Gen4ElcOptions.tsx: Displays Gen 4 model options and handles purchasing or MGP ID validation before checkout.
frontend/src/pages/Gen5Options.tsx: Shows Gen 5 pre‑order options with MGP ID validation and navigation to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page presenting navigation cards for Gen 4 and Gen 5 options.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmation.tsx: React page showing an order confirmation with model and arrival date from URL search params and a button to return home.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, plugins, custom colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and container settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, listing existing features and new requests related to theme toggle updates and adding a green color option.
